metadata.title: dev_tool
metadata.description: Test harness for the HTTP-triggered building-block model. Calls CLOPSSEC_ticket_creation, then create_subtask under the returned parent key, then blob_append (twice, the second call asserting de-duplication) — each the way a live caller does, an HTTPS POST to the block's own Request trigger, no nested-workflow shortcut. Records the status code and response contract of every call, appends the report to a ledger append blob (managed identity, no connection strings) and answers with it. Overwrites the existing dev_tool Logic App in place; no API connections are created.
prerequisites: CLOPSSEC_ticket_creation and create_subtask deployed in the same resource group, each with a Request trigger named 'manual'.
blob_append deployed anywhere reachable over HTTPS; its trigger callback URL is pinned in BlobAppendCallbackUrl rather than resolved at deploy time.
Container '<LedgerContainer>' exists on '<StorageAccountName>'; the dev_tool managed identity holds Storage Blob Data Contributor on that container.
The blob_append managed identity can reach the target in BlobAppendRequest (Storage Blob Data Contributor on the container, Reader on the account).
The deploying principal can list the two Jira playbooks' trigger callback URLs (Logic App Contributor on the RG is enough).
metadata.author: dev_tool

metadata.description: Name of the existing Consumption Logic App to overwrite. Always pass explicitly.
Building block that raises the CLOPSSEC parent ticket. Its 'manual' trigger callback URL is read at deploy time and stored as a secure workflow parameter.
Building block that raises the subtask under the parent. Its 'manual' trigger callback URL is read at deploy time and stored as a secure workflow parameter.

Trigger callback URL of the deployed blob_append block, SAS signature included. Pinned rather than resolved with listCallbackUrl, so blob_append does not have to be deployable from this template's resource group. It is a bearer credential: anyone holding it can invoke blob_append. Rotate it under the blob_append Logic App -> Access keys, then paste the new URL here (or into Logic App Designer -> Parameters, which needs no redeploy). A run can still override it with targets.blob_append_url.
Trackspace base URL, used only to build browse links in the report and the ledger.
Storage account holding the ticket ledger. The playbook's managed identity needs Storage Blob Data Contributor on the container.
Private container for the ledger. Must exist before the first run.
Append blob inside the container; one JSON report per run.
issue_type sent to the ticket-creation block when the request carries none.
Parent ticket summary when the request carries none.

DefaultDescription.defaultValue: Automated test ticket raised by the dev_tool Logic App to validate the CLOPSSEC_ticket_creation -> create_subtask building-block chain. Safe to close.

metadata.description: Parent ticket description when the request carries none.
Subtask summary when the request carries none.

DefaultSubtaskDescription.defaultValue: Automated subtask raised by the dev_tool Logic App under the parent test ticket. Safe to close.

metadata.description: Subtask description when the request carries none.

The request body posted to blob_append, verbatim. Edit it in the portal under Logic App Designer -> Parameters to retarget the test without redeploying. resource_group_name must be the resource group of the storage account itself, which is not necessarily the resource group these playbooks live in; blob_append answers 404 when it is wrong.
After the append, call blob_append a second time with skip_duplicates forced true and assert it appends nothing. Skipped when the request is a dry run.

blob_append.description: Per-run override of the whole blob_append request body. Omit to use the BlobAppendRequest parameter; pass an object to replace it wholesale (it is forwarded to blob_append unchanged, so it takes every field that block accepts).

targets.description: Per-run overrides of the building blocks under test. Omit to use the callback URLs baked in at deploy time; pass an INT or rebuilt block's trigger URL to point this run at it.

ticket_creation_url.description: HTTPS trigger callback URL of the ticket-creation block, SAS query string included.

create_subtask_url.description: HTTPS trigger callback URL of the subtask block, SAS query string included.

blob_append_url.description: HTTPS trigger callback URL of the blob_append block, SAS query string included.

body.error: targets.ticket_creation_url / targets.create_subtask_url / targets.blob_append_url must be https URLs; the playbook holds no usable callback URL for one of the building blocks.

runError.message: No usable https callback URL for one of the building blocks.
